title: Draw a line with a loop
heading: Build a simple line, pixel by pixel.
description: for i in range(6) repeats the indented command with i = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. pixel(1 + i, 2) moves one column right each time while y stays at 2. Those six neighbouring pixels make a horizontal line. Try the vertical and diagonal versions: which coordinate changes?

scene.title: Your picture · 8 × 5 enlarged pixels
scene.label: An enlarged 8-column, 5-row pixel picture. Whole cells are shaded; x counts right from 0 to 7 and y counts down from 0 to 4.

feedback.empty: Your program ran. Add pixel(...) to colour your picture.
feedback.drawn: Compare which coordinates change. Next, explore a diagonal that is less steep.

examples.label: Horizontal: change x
examples.code:
for i in range(6):
    pixel(1 + i, 2)

examples.label: Vertical: change y
examples.code:
for i in range(5):
    pixel(2, i)

examples.label: Diagonal: change both
examples.code:
for i in range(5):
    pixel(i, i)
